verdict.rationale: An IP office with an open-data portal could plausibly publish versioned APIs, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence mentions API versioning or a deprecation policy. The docs cover filing procedures (trademarks, patents, designs, e-Soleau), and the probe only shows that data.inpi.fr returns 403 to keyless requests and needs a token.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
